end.parentNote: Asha practised square and triangular number pictures with Ishita. There was a brief mix-up about adding or subtracting the shared corner, which was corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw a 3×3 and 4×4 dot square and ask Ishita to mark the new row, new column, and shared corner.
